acceptanceCriteria.text: Current Mottainai and shared npm-publish contracts are compared on trigger, version source, package/build checks, artifact identity, provenance, permissions and authentication.
The Issue records one explicit decision: adopted because equivalent/stronger, or retained-local because of named incompatibility.
If adopted, the caller uses an immutable `.github` revision and Trusted Publishing/OIDC with least-privilege permissions.
If adopted, exact packed artifact verification/pre-publish checks remain at least as strong as current Mottainai behavior.
If retained local, no partial/duplicate publish path remains enabled and the exception is documented for #239/.github#10.
No long-lived npm publishing credential is introduced.
Workflow/static tests plus a safe release/dry-run or next governed release evidence validate the selected path without unplanned publication.

issue.title: ci: adopt the shared npm publish workflow only if release semantics are equivalent
